workflows.trigger: Herdr Android/Termux migration request or readiness/runtime evidence
steps: read AGENTS.md, harness doctrine, parent Android harness, Herdr manifest, codebase map and scoped skill
preserve tmux as canonical and product runtime files as read-only
resolve explicit or newest local readiness, install-review and prebuilt execution evidence
render Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py classification
select reviewed-installation, runtime-compatibility-review, bounded-server-start-review, failure-recovery, validation or handoff at the first unproved gate
workflows.proofCeiling: routing from current evidence only; no installation or runtime promotion

workflows.trigger: KEEP_TMUX_HERDR_NOT_INSTALLED without a completed source-bound BLOCKED install review
steps: read tracked upstream installation source snapshot
refresh official source when stale or authority might change
create Build-HerdrInstallReview.py --write artifact
require BLOCKED while official Android/Termux support is unstated and emit no install command
route completed BLOCKED review to runtime-compatibility-review
workflows.proofCeiling: source-bound installation review only; no installation or Android runtime proof

workflows.trigger: source-bound install review is BLOCKED because Android/Termux support is not established
steps: read upstream-runtime-compatibility.json pinned to Herdr v0.8.0
distinguish aarch64-unknown-linux-musl prebuilt from native aarch64-linux-android source build
keep native Android build BLOCKED while target_os=android selects unsupported fallback
render Build-HerdrCompatibilityReview.py --write
permit only exact-size/SHA-256 temporary --version execution probe
never install, start server, attach client, mutate Android policy or remove tmux from this probe
successful same-device identity routes to bounded-server-start-review
workflows.proofCeiling: exact source/build assumptions and ephemeral executable identity only

workflows.trigger: exact same-device herdr-prebuilt-exec evidence proves v0.8.0 execution identity
steps: read upstream-server-start-source.json pinned to the same v0.8.0 release commit and asset digest
render Build-HerdrServerStartReview.py --write
require exact prebuilt PASS evidence before any live server probe downloads or executes
use only explicit foreground `herdr server`; never bare `herdr` auto-detect daemon launch
isolate HOME/XDG directories and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH in the temporary sandbox
prove server readiness only with `herdr status server --json` and exact version/protocol/socket checks
stop only with `herdr server stop`, require foreground process exit and not_running afterward
force-clean temporary descendants on any failed graceful stop and preserve sanitized evidence
do not install, attach a client, create workspace/session state, test detach/background survival, mutate Android policy or remove tmux
on PASS route to separately reviewed bounded-client-attach-review
workflows.proofCeiling: foreground server start/status/stop and isolated local API IPC only; not client attach or persistence

steps: parse shell entrypoints and hooks
run migration, installation-review, compatibility-review, server-start-review and status-state-isolation contracts before harness completeness
run synthetic routing with isolated --state-root so operator evidence cannot change deterministic outcomes
run prebuilt and server-start probes in contract mode only; hosted CI must never run live evidence modes
run PowerShell completeness where available and existing Android Termux floor
run git diff --check and verify generated evidence remains local/untracked
workflows.proofCeiling: tracked harness contracts only; not same-device server proof

workflows.trigger: probe, validator or migration gate failure
steps: preserve first bounded non-sensitive failure evidence
clean-CI/device validator disagreement => isolate ambient state before changing assertions
prebuilt identity failure => keep tmux and do not start server
server prerequisite/download/digest/start/status/stop/exit/cleanup failure => keep tmux and preserve herdr-server-start evidence
successful foreground lifecycle => do not attach client; route to bounded-client-attach-review
tracked validator failure => repair inside harness scope and rerun complete focused floor
render operator report with one next command
workflows.proofCeiling: failure boundary and evidence preservation only

workflows.trigger: focused validation completed or a real authority/runtime blocker remains
steps: run Get-HerdrHarnessStatus.py --write with explicit evidence when known
record repo/branch/head/PR separately from phone evidence
state installation/runtime/server-start source snapshots separately from live proof
state working, blocked, missing, proof reached and proof ceiling
provide one exact executable next command advancing the first unproved gate
keep credentials, device codes, private evidence and machine-local junk out of Git/PR
workflows.proofCeiling: handoff summarizes evidence; it is not additional runtime/merge/deployment proof
